title: 第九章  初闻异兽欲练武道第十章  危机暗藏感情升温
slug: 武道长生从边关猎户开始黄袍加身
lines: “狼群退了！狼群退了！”
猎户们顿时欢呼起来。
钱林心中的巨石落地，这才察觉自己满身是伤，顿时疼得龇牙咧嘴。
中年猎户先是上前查看先前被群狼拖出去围杀的那位猎户，探了探鼻息，顿时朝着两人摇了摇头：
“没救了。”
这也让钱林等人面露不忍，都是在山里讨生活的苦命人，一家老小全靠着他们养活，如今这猎户在山里丢了命，那他们一家的日子怕是难过了。
不过事已至此，钱林也跟这猎户没什么交情，更别说这三人还险些害他丧命，同情也就持续片刻，便直接消散。
钱林眯着眼，看向远方树上的人影，朝着那边招了招手：
“哪位好汉救我们三人一命？还请现身一见，钱林感激不尽。”
只见远处那个人影三两下从树上下来，朝着他们走来，越靠近，钱林越发觉得熟悉。
“钱林哥，你们没事吧。”
熟悉的声音响起，顿时引得钱林张大了嘴巴，磕磕绊绊的说道：
“是我。”
陆川走近三人，上下打量了一下钱林等人。
三人虽然看上去狼狈，但所幸没有受到致命伤。
“兄弟，谢谢你们救我们一命。”
没等钱林说话，中年猎户热情地伸出手，想要跟陆川握手。
陆川看着他满手的血迹，不动声色地退后两步，
“大家都是山里讨生活的人，又何必多礼。”
中年猎户这才想到自己浑身是血，不由尴尬地将双手在身上抹了抹。
钱林上前一步，面露感激：
“陆川，谢谢你。没想到你的箭术这么厉害，隔着有上百米，都能箭箭命中。”
“就算我在山里打了十年猎，也不及你啊。”
“钱林哥，不碍事。”
陆川朝着他笑了笑，随即目光开始四处扫视起来。
当看到不远处的猎户尸体，眼神变得幽深。
很快，陆川回过神来，细数了一下场上的灰狼尸体。
钱林三人杀了五条，而他一个人则杀了九条灰狼。
而且灰狼肉质偏柴，卖不上价钱。
只有那身狼皮，才算是不错的收获。
而且钱林等人杀的灰狼身上都是刀伤，算是劣质品。
而陆川射杀的灰狼，基本身上只有一个箭孔，保存完整，算是上等货色。
content_en:
"The wolves are retreating! The wolves are retreating!"
The hunters immediately cheered.
The boulder in Qian Lin's heart fell to the ground, and then he realized that he was covered in injuries, and he suddenly grimaced in pain.
The middle-aged hunter first stepped forward to check on the hunter who had been dragged out by the pack of wolves to kill him. He sniffed and immediately shook his head at the two of them:
"It's hopeless."
This also made Qian Lin and others look unbearable. They were all poor people struggling to make a living in the mountains. The whole family relied on them to support them. Now that the hunter had lost his life in the mountains, their family's life would probably be difficult.
But at this point, Qian Lin had no friendship with the hunter, not to mention that these three people almost killed him, so his sympathy only lasted for a moment and then dissipated.
Qian Lin squinted his eyes, looked at the figure on the tree in the distance, and waved over there:
"Which hero saved the lives of the three of us? Please show up to see us. Qian Lin is grateful."
I saw the figure in the distance coming down from the tree three or two times and walking towards them. The closer he got, the more familiar Qian Lin felt.
"Brother Qian Lin, are you okay?"
A familiar voice sounded, which immediately caused Qian Lin to open his mouth wide and said stumblingly:
"Are you...Lu Chuan?"
"It's me."
Lu Chuan approached the three of them and looked Qian Lin and others up and down.
Although the three people looked embarrassed, fortunately they were not fatally injured.
"Brother, thank you for saving our lives."
Before Qian Lin could speak, the middle-aged Orion enthusiastically extended his hand to shake hands with Lu Chuan.
Lu Chuan looked at the blood on his hands and took two steps back calmly.
"Everyone is just trying to make a living in the mountains, so why should we be so polite?"
The middle-aged Orion then realized that he was covered in blood, and couldn't help but wipe his hands on his body in embarrassment.
Qian Lin took a step forward with gratitude on his face:
"Lu Chuan, thank you. I didn't expect that your archery skills are so good. You can hit someone hundreds of meters away."
"Even if I hunted in the mountains for ten years, I still wouldn't be as good as you."
"Brother Qian Lin, it's okay."
Lu Chuan smiled at him, and then began to look around.
When he saw the corpse of the hunter not far away, his eyes became dark.
Soon, Lu Chuan came back to his senses and counted the gray wolf corpses on the field.
Qian Lin and the others killed five wolves, while he alone killed nine gray wolves.
Moreover, the meat of gray wolves is relatively woody and cannot be sold at a high price.
Only the wolf skin is considered a good harvest.
Moreover, the gray wolf killed by Qian Lin and others had stab wounds all over its body, so it was regarded as inferior quality.
The gray wolf that Lu Chuan shot basically had only one arrow hole in its body and was completely preserved, so it was considered a top quality product.
